variations.label: Newspaper
variations.prompt: Render the subject as an old-school newspaper Sunday-funnies cartoon: simple linework, limited flat colour palette, light printing texture and a charming vintage comic-strip feel. Keep them recognisable and cartoonised. Wholesome and retro.

variations.label: Boardroom
variations.prompt: Turn this into a polished corporate portrait for a senior professional. Dress the subject in sharp business attire (suit / blazer), place them against a tasteful blurred modern office or boardroom background, add clean flattering lighting and subtle professional retouching. Preserve the person's exact identity, face, hairstyle and expression. Authoritative, LinkedIn-ready and photorealistic.

variations.label: Startup
variations.prompt: Create a modern startup-professional headshot: smart-casual business attire, a bright airy blurred contemporary office background, confident approachable lighting and natural retouching. Preserve the person's exact identity, features and expression. Clean, current and LinkedIn-ready. Photorealistic.

variations.label: Finance
variations.prompt: Create a premium finance/executive corporate portrait: a tailored dark suit, a refined dark or neutral blurred background, crisp directional lighting, sharp detail and subtle professional retouching. Preserve the person's exact identity and features. High-end, authoritative and photorealistic.

variations.label: Magic Eraser
variations.prompt: Remove distracting or unwanted elements from this photo — photobombers, stray people, trash, signs, clutter, blemishes on surfaces and other distractions — and cleanly fill the space with a natural, seamless continuation of the surrounding background. Keep the main subject completely unchanged: identical identity, pose, lighting and detail. The retouch must be invisible and fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Sunset Glow
variations.prompt: Relight this landscape as if captured during a breathtaking golden-hour sunset. Bathe the scene in warm amber and rose-gold light coming low from the horizon: long soft shadows stretching toward the camera, sun-kissed rim light on trees, buildings and terrain, gentle atmospheric haze glowing in the backlight, and a sky graded into layered apricot, coral and soft violet. Keep every element of the original composition, geography and structures exactly in place — only the light, sky and colour mood change. Fully photorealistic, like a professional landscape photographer waited hours for this exact moment.

variations.label: Misty Sunrise
variations.prompt: Transform this scene into a serene early-morning sunrise. Add low, cool-gold light raking across the landscape, delicate ground mist hanging in valleys and between trees, dew-fresh clarity in the foreground, soft pastel sky in pale gold, blush and powder blue, and gentle god-rays where the sun breaks through. Preserve the exact composition, terrain and structures — only lighting, atmosphere and colour change. Photorealistic, tranquil, National-Geographic quality.

variations.label: Blue Hour
variations.prompt: Regrade this scene into the magical blue hour just after sunset: a deep cobalt-and-indigo sky with a faint warm band at the horizon, cool ambient light over the landscape, and any windows, street lamps or city lights glowing warmly against the blue. Balance the exposure like a tripod long-exposure — clean shadows, no noise, crisp detail. Keep the composition and every element exactly in place; only light, sky and mood change. Fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Dramatic Storm
variations.prompt: Replace the sky in this photo with a spectacular dramatic storm sky: towering charcoal cumulonimbus clouds with sculpted sunlit edges, shafts of light breaking through gaps, and a moody, cinematic atmosphere. Match the scene's lighting to the new sky — cooler, directional, with believable shadows and reflections updated to agree with the clouds. Keep the entire landscape and composition untouched otherwise. The blend at the horizon must be seamless and fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Sunset Fire
variations.prompt: Replace the sky with an explosive sunset: molten orange and crimson clouds streaked across the sky, purple-blue upper atmosphere, and the horizon burning gold. Recolour the scene's light to match — warm highlights on surfaces facing the sky, soft magenta fill in the shadows, water and glass reflecting the fire. Keep the landscape, buildings and composition exactly as they are; the sky replacement and relight must be seamless and photorealistic.

variations.label: Starry Night
variations.prompt: Turn this into a stunning night scene under a crystal-clear starry sky: thousands of pin-sharp stars, a luminous Milky Way band arcing across the frame, and deep blue-black cosmic sky. Relight the landscape as a moonlit night — cool silver light, soft shadows, warm glow preserved in any windows or lamps. Keep the entire composition and every element in place. Astro-photography realism: no noise, no fake-looking star shapes, seamless horizon blend.

variations.label: Autumn
variations.prompt: Transform this scene into peak autumn. Turn foliage into rich seasonal colour — flame red maples, amber oaks, golden birches — scatter fallen leaves naturally over the ground, and grade the light into warm, low-angle autumn sun with a crisp, slightly hazy atmosphere. Keep every structural element, the terrain and the composition identical; only vegetation, ground cover, light and colour change with the season. Fully photorealistic, like the same photo re-taken in October.

variations.label: Winter Snow
variations.prompt: Transform this scene into a pristine winter day. Blanket the ground, roofs and branches in realistic fresh snow with natural accumulation and depth, frost the vegetation, add soft cool overcast light with pale blue shadows, and a quiet wintry atmosphere with faint falling snowflakes. Keep the composition, terrain and every structure identical — this must look like the exact same place photographed in January, fully photorealistic with physically believable snow.

variations.label: Spring Bloom
variations.prompt: Transform this scene into radiant spring. Bring vegetation into fresh light-green leaf, add blossoming trees and wildflowers where natural, brighten the light into clear, gentle spring sunshine with a soft blue sky, and give the whole scene a clean, renewed atmosphere. Keep the composition, terrain and structures exactly the same — the same place in full bloom, photorealistic and vibrant without looking oversaturated.

variations.label: Vivid Postcard
variations.prompt: Grade this travel photo into a flawless picture-postcard: perfectly balanced exposure, deep polarised blue sky, rich but believable colour saturation, crystal-clear air with haze removed, crisp detail from foreground to horizon, and inviting warmth. Keep the scene and composition exactly as shot. It should look like the hero image on a premium travel brochure — photorealistic, aspirational, technically perfect.

variations.label: Vintage Postcard
variations.prompt: Restyle this travel photo as a charming 1970s vintage postcard: gently faded Kodachrome-style colours with warm reds and soft cyans, subtle film grain, slightly soft edges, and a nostalgic sun-washed atmosphere. Keep the scene and composition exactly the same. It should feel like a treasured postcard found in a flea market — authentically retro, photorealistic, never a cheap filter.

variations.label: Monarch
variations.prompt: Transform this pet into a majestic royal oil painting. Dress them in regal attire — an ermine-trimmed velvet robe, ornate gold chain and a jewelled crown sized naturally to their head — seated against a dark palatial background with heavy drapery and warm candlelit tones. Render in the style of an 18th-century master portrait: visible brushwork, rich chiaroscuro lighting, museum-quality detail. The pet's face, markings, fur colour and expression must remain perfectly recognisable — it is unmistakably THIS animal as a monarch.

variations.label: The General
variations.prompt: Portray this pet as a distinguished military general in a classical oil painting: a decorated navy dress uniform with gold epaulettes, medals and braid, posed nobly against a smoky battlefield-sky backdrop. Painterly realism in the style of historical military portraiture — confident posture, dramatic light from one side, fine brushwork texture. Keep the pet's face, fur pattern and expression perfectly true to the original photo so the owner instantly recognises their animal.

variations.label: The Duchess
variations.prompt: Portray this pet as an elegant duchess in a romantic classical portrait: a lace-collared silk gown, pearl necklace and a delicate tiara, seated gracefully in a grand salon with soft window light and pastel drapery. Painted in refined rococo style with luminous skin-of-fur rendering, gentle brushstrokes and aristocratic poise. The pet's face, markings and expression must remain exactly recognisable as this specific animal.

variations.label: Classic Studio
variations.prompt: Turn this into a professional studio pet portrait: a clean seamless dark charcoal backdrop, a large softbox key light producing catchlights in the eyes, gentle rim light separating the fur from the background, and crisp focus on the face with every whisker and fur strand resolved. Keep the pet's pose, expression, markings and proportions exactly as in the photo — only the setting and lighting become studio-grade. Photorealistic, award-winning pet-photography quality.

variations.label: Bright & Airy
variations.prompt: Turn this into a bright, joyful studio pet portrait on a pure white seamless background: soft even wraparound lighting, clean true-to-life fur colour, sparkling catchlights, and a fresh commercial feel like a premium pet-brand campaign. Preserve the pet's exact pose, expression and markings. Fully photorealistic with immaculate edge detail around fur.

variations.label: 3D Animated
variations.prompt: Transform this pet into a lovable 3D-animated movie character: big expressive eyes full of personality, soft stylised fur with visible groom, gently exaggerated proportions (larger head, rounder body), warm cinematic lighting and a softly blurred colourful background. Preserve the pet's exact fur colours, markings, ear shape and expression so it is instantly recognisable as this specific animal, starring in its own animated feature.

variations.label: Comic Strip
variations.prompt: Redraw this pet as a charming hand-drawn comic-strip character: clean confident ink outlines, flat cel colours matching their real fur and markings, simple expressive cartoon eyes, and a playful minimal background with a halftone texture. Keep the pose and expression from the photo. It should look like a beloved character from a classic Sunday comic — warm, funny, full of personality.

variations.label: Astronaut
variations.prompt: Put this pet in a highly detailed NASA-style astronaut suit, helmet visor open to show their real face, floating inside a realistic spacecraft interior with Earth glowing through the window behind them. Photorealistic rendering with accurate suit materials, soft cabin lighting and believable zero-gravity fur physics. The pet's face, markings and expression must remain exactly true to the photo — a proud space explorer, unmistakably this animal.

variations.label: Chef
variations.prompt: Portray this pet as a professional head chef: a crisp white chef's jacket and toque, standing at a beautiful restaurant kitchen pass with warm tungsten light, gleaming pans and gentle steam rising in the background. Photorealistic, editorial food-magazine quality, with shallow depth of field. Keep the pet's face, markings and expression exactly recognisable — the culinary genius they were born to be.

variations.label: Pilot
variations.prompt: Portray this pet as a vintage aviator: a leather flight jacket, silk scarf and classic goggles pushed up on their head, seated in an open cockpit with a golden-hour sky and soft clouds behind. Photorealistic with rich material detail and warm heroic lighting. The pet's face, markings and expression stay perfectly true to the photo — a legend of the skies.

variations.label: Pure White
variations.prompt: Re-photograph this object as a flawless e-commerce product shot on a pure white seamless background (RGB 255): perfectly even studio lighting with soft shadows directly beneath the product for grounding, immaculate edges, accurate true-to-life colours and materials, and razor-sharp detail across the whole product. Keep the object's exact shape, proportions, branding and condition — only the environment and lighting change. Amazon/Shopify hero-image quality, fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Soft Studio
variations.prompt: Re-photograph this object as a premium product shot on a soft grey-to-white gradient studio sweep: a large diffused key light modelling the product's form, delicate reflection on a subtly glossy surface beneath it, gentle falloff into the background and crisp, catalogue-grade detail. Preserve the object's exact shape, colours, materials and branding. High-end product photography, fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Black Premium
variations.prompt: Re-photograph this object as a luxury product shot on a deep matte black background: dramatic low-key lighting sculpting the product with precise speculars, a subtle rim light tracing its silhouette, faint reflection below, and rich, true material rendering. Preserve the exact shape, proportions, branding and colours. It should look like a flagship-launch hero image for a premium brand — cinematic, immaculate, photorealistic.

variations.label: Cozy Home
variations.prompt: Place this object naturally into a beautiful lifestyle scene: a warm, softly lit modern home — light oak table or linen surface, out-of-focus plants and morning window light in the background. Integrate it with physically correct shadows, reflections and colour bounce so it truly sits in the scene. Keep the object's exact shape, colours, materials and branding untouched. Aspirational catalogue realism, like a premium brand's Instagram content.

variations.label: Golden Outdoor
variations.prompt: Place this object into a stunning outdoor golden-hour scene — warm sunlight, soft bokeh of nature or a terrace behind, natural surface beneath it (stone, wood or sand as appropriate). Integrate with accurate warm lighting, believable shadows and environmental reflections. The object's shape, colours, materials and branding stay exactly as photographed. Editorial advertising quality, fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Clean Listing
variations.prompt: Optimise this photo for a marketplace listing that sells: isolate the item by replacing the messy background with a clean, softly graded neutral backdrop, correct the white balance so colours are true, brighten and even out the lighting, sharpen the details and remove dust or minor distractions from the surface it sits on. Do NOT alter the item itself — its condition, wear, colour and features must stay perfectly honest and accurate. The result should look trustworthy and professional, like the best listings on eBay or Vinted.

variations.label: Bright & Sharp
variations.prompt: Enhance this listing photo in place: fix the exposure and white balance, lift the shadows, sharpen fine detail, reduce noise and make the item's true colours pop naturally — keeping the original setting but making everything look clean, bright and professional. Do NOT change the item's condition or appearance; honesty sells. The result should read as a well-photographed, high-trust marketplace listing.

variations.label: Michelin
variations.prompt: Re-photograph this dish as a Michelin-starred editorial: moody directional window light raking across the plate, deep shadows with luminous highlights on sauces and textures, an elegant dark ceramic or stone table setting, shallow depth of field, and micro-detail on every garnish and glaze. Keep the actual dish, its ingredients, portion and arrangement exactly as photographed — only lighting, styling of the surroundings and grading change. Fine-dining magazine cover quality, fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Rustic Bistro
variations.prompt: Restyle this dish photo as warm rustic-bistro editorial: golden ambient light, a textured wooden table, soft linen napkin and blurred candlelight in the background, with the food's colours rich and appetising and steam gently visible if the dish is hot. Keep the dish itself — ingredients, portion, arrangement — exactly as photographed. Cozy, inviting, cookbook-quality photorealism.

variations.label: Golden & Crispy
variations.prompt: Make this food look absolutely irresistible: deepen golden-brown crusts and char marks, add a fresh glisten to sauces and oils, enhance rising steam for hot dishes, saturate the natural colours of every ingredient to peak appetising vibrancy, and sharpen the textures — crisp edges, tender interiors. Keep the exact same dish, portion and arrangement; this is the same plate at its absolute best. Fast-food-commercial craveability, fully photorealistic.

variations.label: Fresh & Vibrant
variations.prompt: Make this food look garden-fresh and vibrant: brighten and clarify the natural colours — crisp greens, juicy reds, creamy whites — add delicate water droplets on fresh produce, clean up the plate edges, and light it with airy, soft daylight. Keep the exact dish, ingredients and arrangement unchanged. Healthy-lifestyle editorial quality: fresh, clean, photorealistic, genuinely appetising.

variations.label: Warm Glow
variations.prompt: Apply a moderate warm color temperature shift, balancing reds and oranges with cooler tones for a harmonious look. Enhance contrast to deepen blacks and brighten highlights, achieving a dynamic range. Adjust sharpening to create a crisper texture, while maintaining subtlety. Introduce a gentle vignette to subtly draw focus towards the center. Soften the halation effect to ensure a delicate glow around bright areas, enhancing the dramatic lighting and emphasizing the subject.
